bot_replies.cannot_promote_self: ⚠️ *Security Restriction:* You cannot promote yourself. Only existing Group Admins can promote other members.
bot_replies.cannot_promote_bot: ⚠️ *Security Restriction:* The bot account cannot be promoted or demoted via chat commands. Please use WhatsApp Group Info settings.
bot_replies.demote_mention_required: ⚠️ You must mention a user or reply to their message to demote them.
bot_replies.cannot_demote_bot: ⚠️ *Security Restriction:* The bot account cannot be demoted via chat commands.
bot_replies.approve_mention_required: ⚠️ You must mention a user to approve them.
bot_replies.approve_success: ✅ Approved {count} user(s). They will bypass moderation locks.
bot_replies.unapprove_mention_required: ⚠️ You must mention a user to unapprove them.
